objective: test 0.7 mm isotropic clipped-linear-HU VoxTell finetuning under the exp007 DDP global-batch-4 recipe

initialization.load_policy: load public model weights directly; do not initialize from exp007 or any other fine-tuned checkpoint
initialization.optimizer_resume: resume only between exp017 DDP segments

continuation.load_policy: load network weights only with --init-checkpoint; reset optimizer, AMP scaler, scheduler, RNG-controlled run state, and update counter
continuation.schedule_policy: generate 80000 deterministic iso07 DDP events, verify first 40000 match original Exp017 phase-1 schedule, then rewrite source events 40000-79999 to a zero-based 40000-event continuation schedule

preprocessing.normalization: crop native CT to nonzero, clip HU to [-1024,1024], divide by 1024, then trilinear 0.7 mm isotropic resampling
preprocessing.physical_fov_caveat: A 192^3 model patch at 0.7 mm covers about 134.4 mm per axis, so this is a geometry plus normalization experiment, not a pure HU-normalization ablation.

schedule.prompt_policy: multi-finding 2 positive + 1 negative; one-finding 1 positive + 2 negatives; every selected positive nonempty in its sampled patch
schedule.schedule_note: Phase 1 generates a fresh schedule from iso07 cached metadata. Phase 2 uses the second 40000-event slice from a deterministic 80000-event iso07 stream. Do not require coordinate-prefix identity with native-cache schedules.

training.augmentation: none added beyond VoxTell patch sampling

validation.eval_policy: training pauses at each segment; val200 inference is sharded over all four GPUs; fixed JSON is passed directly
validation.restore_policy: predict on the iso07 cached crop, trilinearly restore probabilities to native cropped shape, insert into native reoriented image, then export to released-label layout

comparison_plan.primary_baseline: exp007 DDP bs4 native z-score e5/d4 epoch100 val200
comparison_plan.phase2_primary_baseline: exp007 phase-2 continuation from epoch100 using the same weights-only fresh-optimizer protocol
comparison_plan.phase2_source_checkpoint: exp017 epoch100, not exp017 epoch50, to mirror exp007 phase-2

differences_from_exp007: Generate schedule coordinates from iso07 cached metadata.
Restore validation predictions from iso07 cached crop space to native label space before evaluation.
Keep DDP world size, effective batch size, optimizer, loss, checkpoint cadence, and val200 cadence matched to exp007.
